page.overview:
Who is Cana?

Cana was a Human female who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. When Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local droids, Cana rushed to help her injured neighbor Benett, and the two were defended from additional droids by Havoc Squad.
